feb_overview.reference_sql:
WITH line_totals AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) amount FROM items GROUP BY order_id),
        refund_totals AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount) refund FROM refunds WHERE status='settled' GROUP BY order_id),
        c AS (SELECT o.*,l.amount,COALESCE(r.refund,0) refund FROM orders o JOIN line_totals l USING(order_id)
        LEFT JOIN refund_totals r USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='completed') SELECT SUM(amount) sales,COUNT(*) orders,AVG(amount) aov FROM c WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-02%'
